definitionZh: padding-block-start CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑块开始padding,它根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,映射到物理padding.
sourceDefinition: The padding-block-start CSS property defines the logical block start padding of an element, which maps to a physical padding depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
